<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="0.5" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="jEukNXusVT6zU5M1Q2xe"> <mxGraphModel dx="3000" dy="1163" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%% Logistics-Route-Decider-System - Navigation model (Lab 10)
%% Editable source. Render at https://mermaid.live. Exported view: models/navigation.svg
%% Thick arrows (==>) mark critical task paths: T1 generate route, T2 record delivery, T3 reassign route.
flowchart LR
 LOGIN[\"Login\"]

 subgraph D[\"DISPATCHER - web (desktop browser)\"]
 DASH[\"Dashboard:<br/>Pending Deliveries<br/>(landing)\"]
 REV[\"Route Review<br/>(draft route)\"]
 ACT[\"Active Routes\"]
 DET[\"Route Detail<br/>(stops, status, reorder)\"]
 REA[\"Reassign Driver<br/>(dialog)\"]
 DRV[\"Drivers<br/>(availability)\"]
 REP[\"Reports and History\"]
 NAV[\"Top navigation on every screen:<br/>Dashboard | Active Routes | Drivers | Reports\"]
 end

 subgraph R[\"DRIVER - mobile\"]
 MY[\"My Route<br/>(landing)\"]
 NODE[\"Delivery Detail\"]
 end

 LOGIN -- \"role = Dispatcher\" --> DASH
 LOGIN -- \"role = Driver\" --> MY

 DASH == \"T1: Generate Route\" ==> REV
 REV == \"T1: Confirm and Assign\" ==> ACT
 REV -- \"Cancel / edit selection\" --> DASH

 ACT -- \"open route\" --> DET
 ACT == \"T3: Reassign (row action)\" ==> REA
 DET -- \"Reassign\" --> REA
 REA -- \"Confirm returns to\" --> ACT

 NAV -.-> DRV
 NAV -.-> REP
 NAV -.-> ACT

 MY == \"T2: tap delivery\" ==> NODE
 NODE == \"T2: tap Completed / Failed / Pending\" ==> MY",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
